thread:
sara-pm: SummitWave SI hit a blocker during marketplace operator install for their GPU appliance image into GovCloud. Validation fails and customer go-live is in 48h. Need triage and escalation.
josh-se: What error are they seeing?
sara-pm: Partner webhook: "signature verification failed: unsupported sig alg 'ED25519-PSS' for manifest mediaType" then later kubelet shows imagePull backoff with AccessDenied for layer fetch. Logs: https://s3.redwood.internal/summitwave/onboard/manifest-3199993210.log
li-ml: That's unusual usually we see KMS decrypt problems. Signature alg mismatch suggests our marketplace signing pipeline used a new algorithm and GovCloud verifier hasn't been updated. Also check the replicated layers permissions.
ben-sre: I'll repro in staging. Can someone DM the partner assume-role for their marketplace-replica role? Also need the exact manifest sha.
summit-ops: DM sent to ben-sre with role arn and short-lived creds. Manifest SHA: sha256:abc123... full log at above link.
natalie-sec: Two fronts: 1) signature algorithm compatibility between our signing service and GovCloud verifier, 2) cross-account ECR/KMS permissions for layer decryption. We need both fixed. I can approve a scoped temporary key-policy exception but org-owner must be CC'd.
josh-se: Quick repro plan: assume partner role in staging and attempt `skopeo inspect --raw docker://...@sha256:abc123` to validate manifest, and `aws ecr batch-get-image` with the role to test layer access.
ben-sre: Ran skopeo -> fails with "unsupported signature algorithm". After switching verifier to accept PSS in staging it progressed but then `ecr:GetDownloadUrlForLayer` failed with AccessDenied.
li-ml: So two blockers. Short-term options: a) patch verifier in GovCloud to accept PSS (fast), b) apply scoped ECR read + temporary KMS decrypt policy for the partner role (fast but requires sec signoff), c) fallback: provide a region-local AMI signed with legacy alg for immediate go-live.
summit-ops: Partner prefers option c for go-live, and will test patched verifier tomorrow. They can also re-generate signed image with legacy RSA if needed but that adds CI cycles.
natalie-sec: I'll fast-track a 3-hour key-policy exception limited to alias/summitwave-gov-key and principal arn:aws-us-gov:iam::777777777:role/summitwave-replica. Must be audited and auto-reverted. Filing ticket SEC-8033.
natalie-sec: Org-owner paging now for emergency signoff: @ceo-owner please advise.
ops-bot: ops-bot: scheduled job 'summitwave-verifier-staging' at 02:00 UTC -> https://deploy.redwood.dev/jobs/summitwave-verifier-staging
ben-sre: After temporary KMS entry and scoped ECR read the staging pull succeeded. But we should avoid long-term cross-account decrypt.
li-ml: I'll coordinate a verifier patch rollout in GovCloud to support PSS. That will remove the need for partner to re-sign images. Timeline ~6-8h including canary.
josh-se: IAM snippet used for scoped ECR in staging: ```json
{ "Effect":"Allow","Action":["ecr:GetDownloadUrlForLayer","ecr:BatchGetImage"],"Resource":"arn:aws-us-gov:ecr:us-gov-west-1:111111111:repository/marketplace/summitwave/*" }
```
summit-ops: Partner ran marketplace validation in staging after the temporary fixes and reported pass. They will flip to the region-local AMI for immediate customer go-live, then validate verifier patch tomorrow.
natalie-sec: SEC-8033 created: 1) auto-revert key-policy at T+3h, 2) CloudTrail alert for CrossAccountDecrypt, 3) postmortem to document verifier alg compatibility.
sara-pm: Next steps: a) partner uses fallback AMI for go-live (short-term), b) li-ml to roll verifier patch and test canary in GovCloud, c) revert temporary key policy after validation (natalie-sec), d) follow-up ticket to implement re-encrypt-on-replication and signer-versioning docs. Confluence notes: https://confluence.redwood.internal/partners/summitwave/onboarding.
ben-sre: I'll own the prod canary if verifier patch is ready.
summit-ops: Thanks everyone. We'll proceed with AMI fallback tonight and validate the new verifier tomorrow morning. Will update here once done. :thumbsup:
